name: Doubly na Kanojo ~H na Jonan ka Dou ka wa Sateoki~
original_name: ダブリーな彼女 ～Hな女難かどうかはさておき～
source:
The protagonist's life has been nothing but disaster.
The fiascos he encounters are always woman-related.

Indeed, he has "girl problems".

Every time he meets one it's another wild ride.

"Here let me take off your pants" = problem
Girl wanking him with her hands = problem
Girl in sexy school swimsuit = problem
Maid uniforms and cheerleaders = problem

Sounds like one of them good problems to me! 

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE065944.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公的一生就是一场灾难。
他遇到的惨败总是与女人有关。

确实，他有“女孩问题”。

每次他遇到一个人，都会是另一场疯狂的旅程。

“让我脱掉你的裤子”=问题
女孩用手自慰他=问题
穿着性感学校泳装的女孩 = 问题
女仆服和啦啦队=问题

对我来说听起来是个好问题之一！
